name: Recover without boarding new passengers
description: Start 12 stops and four evenly spaced buses with fixed passenger arrivals. Hold Bus 1 for 60 seconds at minute 20. From minute 25 through minute 60, check every 15 seconds. When an eligible bus has more than 110% of ideal gap ahead and less than 90% behind, give it drop-off-only service for three stop locations, including the activation stop, capped at ten minutes. Existing riders reach their destinations; waiting passengers use a subsequent suitable bus. Compare passengers passed over, oldest queue wait and completed-trip time with the same delay alone.
